srinagar-leh-highway-kargil-leh.slogan: Kargil to Leh, over 4108 m · one way, about 359 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Kargil

waypoints.name: Lamayuru

waypoints.name: Fotu La

waypoints.name: Leh

sections.advice: Kargil → Lamayuru is 82 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Lamayuru → Fotu La climbs about 4108 m in 9 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Fotu La → Leh drops about 4108 m over 86 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

srinagar-leh-highway-kargil-leh.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Srinagar-Leh Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Srinagar-Leh Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 4108 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Fotu La → Leh
scenicChapters.narrative: 174 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

srinagar-leh-highway-kargil-leh.story: From Kargil it runs 359 km to Leh; allow about 4 h 55 of riding. The stops in between: Lamayuru and Fotu La. The highest point is about 4,600 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
